description: This file defines the main React application component for a dashboard frontend. It includes internal hooks for viewport detection, a desktop-only overlay component, and the main App component that manages routing and access restrictions based on viewport size.

methods.name: useIsBelowDesktopBreakpoint
methods.description: Custom React hook that detects if the viewport width is below a specified breakpoint (default 1024px), updating reactively on window resize.

methods.name: DesktopOnlyOverlay
methods.description: React component that displays an overlay message indicating the app requires a desktop environment, shown when viewport is narrower than 1024px.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component that manages routing and access control, displaying the overlay on small viewports and rendering application routes otherwise.
